Questions · About the money

The ones people actually ask.

Is the $90 a month on top of the $750?

No. Growth includes the hosting and security, so it replaces the $90 rather than stacking on top of it. You are on one or the other, never both.

Am I locked in?

No. Everything ongoing is month to month. Give me a month if you want to stop and I will hand over the site and the domain.

What if my job is bigger than the standard build?

Then it gets quoted properly after a look. More pages, a shop, moving an existing site across, anything custom. I would rather give you a real number than pretend everything fits in one price.

Why half up front?

Because you should not have to hand over four grand to someone who has not built you anything yet, and I should not build a whole site for someone who might disappear. Half and half means we are both in it.
